item.name: 4 Employees read update delete as owner

exec: pm.test("List employees as A -> status 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const list = pm.response.json();
pm.test("A sees own employee", function () { pm.expect(list.some(function (e) { return e._id === pm.collectionVariables.get("empA1"); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("A does not see B's employee", function () { pm.expect(list.some(function (e) { return e._id === pm.collectionVariables.get("empB1"); })).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("List employees as B -> status 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const list = pm.response.json();
pm.test("B sees own employee", function () { pm.expect(list.some(function (e) { return e._id === pm.collectionVariables.get("empB1"); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("B does not see A's employee", function () { pm.expect(list.some(function (e) { return e._id === pm.collectionVariables.get("empA1"); })).to.eql(false); });
